name: Duelbits
rootCause: An attacker moved ~$6.07 million from Duelbits' hot wallets across five chains in a suspected private-key compromise, including the replacement wallet named after its $4.6 million theft in 2024. It reopened days later, cause still undisclosed. What changed since 2024?

descriptions.text: An attacker moved ~$6.07 million from Duelbits' hot wallets across five chains in a suspected private-key compromise, including the replacement wallet named after its $4.6 million theft in 2024. It reopened days later, cause still undisclosed. What changed since 2024?

Crypto casino and sportsbook Duelbits had its hot wallets drained across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Tron, Solana and Bitcoin in under an hour. The team confirmed a loss of about $7,000,000 and took the site offline. Security firms assessed the incident as a hot-wallet private-key compromise, not a smart-contract exploit. The attacker then bridged and swapped most of the stolen assets into ETH and consolidated them in one address. Duelbits said user balances were unaffected, relaunched on September 27 with about $8,000,000 across hot and cold wallets for payouts, and no public recovery or freeze of the stolen funds has been reported.

The Duelbits crypto gambling site lost around $7 million to an apparent hot wallet compromise. The site went offline shortly after the attack, and the company has said the site will stay offline "until we have clarity". The Curaçao-based platform offers casino games and sportsbetting.
